nodes.label: Car Assist Mini-App
nodes.rationale: Driver-safe design: huge tap targets, min ~18-22px body text, no multi-step menus or long confirm modals while driving; launch_app uses a short spoken confirm with a 1.2s window (or settings.autoLaunch). Voice and text only — no camera, QR, file picker, gallery, or rich HTML cards.

nodes.label: window.ForgeHost API
nodes.rationale: ONLY window.ForgeHost / window.forge is allowed; async + try/catch everywhere, no API keys in HTML, capabilities discovered at runtime via ForgeHost.getCapabilities() so phone-only APIs are never assumed on AAForge.

nodes.label: ForgeHost.ai (chat, transcribe, tts, listVoices)
nodes.source_location: Audio pipeline / LLM chat + tool loop

nodes.label: captureUtterance()
nodes.rationale: Native speech recognition is preferred because it is fast and on-device — ideal for the car loop; recording a short clip + cloud STT via ai.transcribe is the fallback, then startRecord/stopRecord if listen/record are missing.

nodes.label: toggleListen()
nodes.source_location: Audio pipeline (Listen session) > Main listen loop
nodes.rationale: While SPEAKING, the next listen is not started until TTS finishes (or 30s timeout) so the assistant does not hear itself; empty transcripts are ignored and duplicate identical transcripts within 1.5s are debounced; abort generation counter cleanly cancels in-flight work on Stop.

nodes.label: loadVoices()
nodes.rationale: Voice lists are normalized so objects are never placed in <option> text; cloud voices are listed first and 'System default (Android TTS)' is always included as a fallback value.

nodes.label: speakAnswer()
nodes.rationale: mode:'auto' is critical because it falls back to Android TTS; if a selected cloud voice fails at speak time it retries once with mode:'native' and toasts 'Cloud voice unavailable — using Android TTS'. Speech is stripped of markdown and truncated to 800 chars to keep answers short.

nodes.label: buildToolList()
nodes.source_location: LLM chat + tool loop > Expose AAForge-capable tools
nodes.rationale: Apps tools (list_apps, list_activities, launch_app) are ALWAYS included as the required focus; all other tools are added only when capability detection reports them available on the host.

nodes.label: fn() tool schema helper
nodes.source_location: LLM chat + tool loop > Expose AAForge-capable tools

nodes.label: executeTool()
nodes.source_location: LLM chat + tool loop > executeTool → ForgeHost / AAForgeHost mappings
nodes.rationale: Optional APIs are probed with try/catch; if a capability is missing the tool returns {ok:false,error:'unsupported on this host'} so the app never crashes on hosts lacking contacts/sms APIs.

nodes.label: runAssistantTurn()
nodes.source_location: LLM chat + tool loop > runAssistantTurn — tool loop + multi-format binding
nodes.rationale: The mini-app owns the full tool-calling loop (bind tools, execute, feed results, re-call) with maxToolRounds (default 4); compact history stores only user + assistant final messages (tool rows dropped) with a ~6 message memory window to keep payloads small.

nodes.label: normalizeChatResult()
nodes.rationale: Only tool names present in the active tool list are accepted (prevents arbitrary code fantasies); handles OpenAI, legacy function_call, camelCase proxies, Anthropic-like parts, choices[0].message passthrough, and text-protocol tools for LLMs without native tooling; arguments must be re-stringified for assistant.tool_calls when re-sending.

nodes.label: buildSystemPrompt()
nodes.source_location: LLM chat + tool loop > System prompt (short, car-oriented)

nodes.label: Listen Session State Machine
nodes.source_location: Audio pipeline (Listen session) > Session state machine
nodes.rationale: Stop from any state must cleanly cancel in-flight work via abort flags, mic.stop and tts.stop so no further STT/TTS runs after the user taps Stop.

nodes.label: Mini-App Managed Tool-Calling Loop
nodes.source_location: Product goal / LLM chat + tool loop
nodes.rationale: The mini-app owns the full tool-calling loop (bind tools, execute, feed results, re-call) rather than delegating it to the host, exposing as much of the AAForge / car ForgeHost surface as exists to the model.

nodes.label: Text-Protocol Tool Formats
nodes.source_location: normalizeChatResult — diverse LLM tool formats > Text-protocol tools
nodes.rationale: Tool format resilience: supports ```tool / ```json blocks, <tool>/<tool_call> tags and conservative 'call tool X with {..}' regex for LLMs without native tooling; if a provider errors on the tools parameter, retry once without tools and rely on text-protocol scraping only.

nodes.label: AAForge (Android Auto host)
nodes.rationale: mic.listen may be stubbed on Android Auto; the app must degrade gracefully — show 'Voice input limited on Android Auto — use Type instead or phone Forge' and keep the text path working while ai.chat, tts, apps list/launch, phone/sms/contacts, http and storage remain available.

nodes.label: Listen Session State Machine
